# Vietnam Thermal Power Plant Inventory - Sector Overview

Vietnam's electricity system has transformed from hydro-dominant to thermal-heavy over the past decade. As of 2018, total installed capacity reached ~47 GW, with thermal plants comprising 55%+ of the mix. The government targets 130+ GW by 2030 through successive Power Development Plans (PDP7 2011, PDP7 adjusted 2016, PDP8 2023). Coal remains dominant, fueled by domestic Vinacomin (TKV) production and rising imports. Gas generation faces declining domestic output, prompting aggressive LNG terminal development at Quảng Ninh, Hải Phòng, Nghi Sơn, Hải Lăng, Cà Ná, Bạc Liêu, and Long An. Key actors include state utilities (EVN, GENCOs 1-3), PVN, TKV, and foreign BOT investors (Marubeni, KEPCO, Sumitomo, etc.). Many projects face delays of 1-5+ years due to financing, fuel supply, and site issues, with several coal projects cancelled or converted to LNG.

## Plant Complex Development Histories

### Uông Bí Complex (Quảng Ninh)
Development history: Original 105 MW subcritical plant commissioned in 1981-1990 by EVN. 330 MW subcritical extension (Uông Bí mở rộng II) added in 2010. Second 330 MW supercritical extension (Uông Bí mở rộng II) commissioned in 2015 under EVN JSC. Status confidence: HIGH (multiple official reports). Status: Operational. Technology: Subcritical (original), Supercritical (extension). No major financing changes.

### Phả Lại Complex (Hải Phòng)
Development history: Phả Lại I (440 MW, subcritical) commissioned 1984-1985. Phả Lại II (600 MW, subcritical) commissioned 2001-2004 by EVN JSC. Phả Lại 3 (660 MW, supercritical) proposed for 2025-2030. Status confidence: HIGH for operational units, MEDIUM for proposed Phả Lại 3. Status: I & II Operational, III Proposed. Technology progression from subcritical to supercritical. No ownership changes.

### Vĩnh Tân Complex (Bình Thuận)
Development history: Vĩnh Tân 2 (1,244 MW, supercritical) commissioned 2015. Vĩnh Tân 4 (1,200 MW, ultra-supercritical) commissioned 2017-2018, 3 months early. Vĩnh Tân 4 mở rộng (600 MW) commissioned 2019 on schedule. Vĩnh Tân 3 (1,980 MW, USC) under construction with BOT investor, delayed 2 years to 2024-2025. Vĩnh Tân 5 & 6 proposed but unlikely. Status confidence: HIGH (government tracking). Notable issues: Vĩnh Tân 3 faces financing and site challenges; Vĩnh Tân 5/6 uncertain due to coal policy shift.

### Duyên Hải Complex (Trà Vinh)
Development history: Duyên Hải 1 (600 MW, supercritical) commissioned 2015. Duyên Hải 3 (1,244 MW, ultra-supercritical) commissioned 2016-2017, 6 months early. Duyên Hải 3 mở rộng (660 MW) commissioned 2019 on schedule. Duyên Hải 2 (600 MW) BOT commissioned 2021-2022, delayed 1 year. Status confidence: HIGH. No ownership changes for EVN units; Duyên Hải 2 is BOT.

### Sông Hậu Complex (Hậu Giang)
Development history: Sông Hậu I (600 MW, supercritical) under construction by PVN, delayed 2 years to 2021-2022. Sông Hậu II (2,120 MW, ultra-supercritical) BOT under construction, delayed 3 years to 2027. Sông Hậu III (2,000 MW) proposed for 2029-2030. Status confidence: MEDIUM-HIGH. Notable issues: PVN financing difficulties; BOT negotiations prolonged; fuel supply concerns.

### Long Phú Complex (Sóc Trăng)
Development history: Long Phú I (600 MW, supercritical) under construction by PVN since 2019, 78% complete but suspended due to US sanctions on equipment suppliers. Long Phú II (1,320 MW, USC) BOT delayed 8+ years to 2029-2030. Long Phú III (1,800 MW) transferred from PVN to Banpu Thailand. Status confidence: HIGH. Notable issues: US sanctions caused 48-month delay; ownership transfer; financing failures.

### Quảng Trạch Complex (Quảng Bình)
Development history: Quảng Trạch I (1,200 MW, ultra-supercritical) transferred from PVN to EVN in 2020, now under construction with 2.5-year delay to 2024-2025. Quảng Trạch II (1,200 MW, USC) proposed for 2026, EVN requested early development. LNG conversion for Quảng Trạch II approved in 2022. Status confidence: HIGH. Notable issues: Ownership transfer; PVN financing problems; conversion to LNG.

### Nghi Sơn Complex (Thanh Hóa)
Development history: Nghi Sơn I (600 MW, supercritical) commissioned 2013-2014. Nghi Sơn II (1,200 MW, ultra-supercritical) BOT commissioned 2022, delayed ~1 year. Status confidence: HIGH. BOT investors: Marubeni-KEPCO. Notable issues: Financing arrangement changes; delayed commissioning.

### Vũng Áng Complex (Hà Tĩnh)
Development history: Vũng Áng I (600 MW, supercritical) commissioned 2013-2014 by PVN. Vũng Áng II (1,200 MW, USC) BOT under construction, delayed to 2026-2027. Vũng Áng III (1,200 MW) cancelled due to coal policy. LNG conversion approved for Vũng Áng II in 2022. Status confidence: HIGH. Notable issues: BOT financing delays; coal-to-LNG conversion; cancellation of Phase III.

### Thái Bình Complex (Thái Bình)
Development history: Thái Bình I (600 MW, supercritical) commissioned 2017 on schedule by EVN. Thái Bình II (1,200 MW, supercritical) BOT delayed 3 years to 2021, then further delayed. Status confidence: HIGH. Notable issues: PVN financing challenges; multiple delays.

### LNG Terminal Projects (Multiple Locations)
Development history: PDP8 (2023) lists 15+ LNG terminals: Quảng Ninh, Thái Bình, Nghi Sơn, Quảng Trạch (converted), Hải Lăng, Cà Ná, Bạc Liêu, Long An, Long Sơn, Hiệp Phước, etc. Most are in planning/pre-FS stage. Delays of 1-3 years common. Status confidence: MEDIUM (many still conceptual). Notable issues: Fuel supply agreements incomplete; high costs; environmental approvals pending.
